title: GhostClaw Knowledge Vault Index
description: Validates the knowledge vault index YAML that catalogs documents, references, and knowledge artifacts across the SIRINX OS ecosystem.

entries.description: Indexed knowledge entries available to agents in the operating system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the knowledge entry.

title.description: Human-readable title of the knowledge artifact.

category.description: Broad category grouping the knowledge artifact belongs to.

source_path.description: Filesystem path or URI where the source artifact is located.

format.description: File format of the source artifact.

projects.description: Project IDs that this knowledge entry is relevant to.

tags.description: Arbitrary tags for search and filtering.

freshness.description: Subjective assessment of how up-to-date this entry is.

summary.description: Brief description or abstract of the knowledge artifact.
